title: Convergence Rate of the Last Iterate of Stochastic Proximal Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2602.05489v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We analyze two classical algorithms for solving additively composite convex optimization problems where the objective is the sum of a smooth term and a nonsmooth regularizer. The first algorithm is the proximal stochastic gradient method for a single regularizer; the second is the randomized incremental proximal method, which uses the proximal operator of a randomly selected function when the regularizer is given as the sum of many nonsmooth functions. We focus on relaxing the bounded variance assumption that is common, yet stringent, for getting last iterate convergence rates. We prove the $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate of convergence for the last iterate of both algorithms under componentwise convexity and smoothness, which is optimal up to log terms. translated_title: 随机邻近算法最后迭代点的收敛速率
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.05489v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要： 我们分析了两种求解可加复合凸优化问题的经典算法，该问题的目标函数是光滑项与非光滑正则项之和。第一种算法是针对单一正则项的随机梯度邻近方法；第二种是随机增量邻近方法，当正则项表示为许多非光滑函数之和时，该方法使用随机选取函数的邻近算子。我们重点关注放松获得最后迭代点收敛速率时常见但苛刻的有界方差假设。我们在逐分量凸性与光滑性条件下，证明了两种算法最后迭代点的 $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ 收敛速率，该速率在对数因子意义下是最优的。我们的结果可直接应用于多任务学习和联邦学习中出现的图引导正则项，其中正则项可分解为协作图上各边函数之和。
tldr: 本文在放松有界方差假设的条件下，证明了随机梯度邻近方法与随机增量邻近方法的最后迭代点在逐分量凸性与光滑性下达到对数因子意义下最优的 $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ 收敛速率，并可直接应用于多任务与联邦学习中的图引导正则项。
en_tdlr: This paper relaxes the common bounded variance assumption and proves the optimal $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ last-iterate convergence rate for both the proximal stochastic gradient method and the randomized incremental proximal method under componentwise convexity and smoothness, directly applicable to graph-guided regularizers in multi-task and federated learning.
